info_cards.title: Famous Photograph: V-J Day in Times Square

info_cards.title: Famous Painting: Composition with Red, Blue and Yellow
info_cards.fact: "Composition with Red, Blue and Yellow" by Piet Mondrian. An abstract painting using only straight lines and primary colours.

info_cards.title: Famous Painting: Black Square
info_cards.fact: "Black Square" by Kazimir Malevich. A pioneering abstract painting that is simply a black square on a white background.

info_cards.title: Famous Painting: Guernica
info_cards.fact: "Guernica" by Pablo Picasso. A large mural painted in shades of grey symbolizing the suffering caused by war.

info_cards.title: Famous Painting: Three Musicians
info_cards.fact: "Three Musicians" by Pablo Picasso. A Cubist painting of three colourful musical figures playing instruments.

info_cards.title: Famous Painting: Girl Before a Mirror
info_cards.fact: "Girl Before a Mirror" by Pablo Picasso. A Cubist painting showing a young woman looking at her reflection.

info_cards.title: Famous Painting: The Old Guitarist
info_cards.fact: "The Old Guitarist" by Pablo Picasso. A painting from Picasso's Blue Period showing a musician bent over his guitar.

info_cards.title: Famous Painting: Boy with a Pipe
info_cards.fact: "Boy with a Pipe" by Pablo Picasso. A Rose Period portrait of a young Parisian boy holding a pipe.

info_cards.title: Famous Painting: The Weeping Woman
info_cards.fact: "The Weeping Woman" by Pablo Picasso. A Cubist portrait expressing sorrow through fragmented, colourful shapes.

info_cards.title: Famous Painting: Composition VII
info_cards.fact: "Composition VII" by Wassily Kandinsky. One of Kandinsky's most complex abstract works, full of swirling shapes and colour.

info_cards.title: Famous Painting: Le Bonheur de Vivre
info_cards.fact: "Le Bonheur de Vivre" by Henri Matisse. A colourful Fauvist painting of figures dancing and relaxing in a landscape.

info_cards.title: Famous Sculpture: George Washington (Greenough)
info_cards.fact: "George Washington (Greenough)" by Horatio Greenough. A large marble statue of the first U.S. president, now in the Smithsonian.

info_cards.title: Famous Sculpture: Minute Man Statue
info_cards.fact: "Minute Man Statue" by Daniel Chester French. A statue in Concord, Massachusetts, honouring American colonial militia.

info_cards.title: Famous Sculpture: Iwo Jima Memorial
info_cards.fact: "Iwo Jima Memorial" by Felix de Weldon. A large bronze statue honouring U.S. Marines, based on a famous wartime photograph.

info_cards.title: Famous Sculpture: The Navy-Merchant Marine Memorial
info_cards.fact: "The Navy-Merchant Marine Memorial" by Marisol Escobar. A bronze relief sculpture in Washington, D.C., honouring naval and merchant sailors.

info_cards.title: Famous Sculpture: Albert Einstein Memorial
info_cards.fact: "Albert Einstein Memorial" by Robert Berks. A large bronze statue of the famous scientist seated with a star map, in Washington, D.C.

info_cards.title: Famous Sculpture: Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial
info_cards.fact: "Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial" by Lei Yixin. A large granite relief statue in Washington, D.C., honouring the civil rights leader.

info_cards.title: Famous Sculpture: Crazy Horse Memorial
info_cards.fact: "Crazy Horse Memorial" by Korczak Ziolkowski. An enormous mountain carving in South Dakota, still being completed, honouring a Lakota leader.

info_cards.title: Famous Sculpture: The Marines' Memorial (El Alamein)
info_cards.fact: "The Marines' Memorial (El Alamein)" by Basil Spence. A war memorial sculpture honouring soldiers, located in Egypt.

info_cards.title: Famous Sculpture: Hachiko Statue
info_cards.fact: "Hachiko Statue" by Teru Ando. A bronze statue in Tokyo honouring a famously loyal Akita dog.

info_cards.title: Famous Sculpture: Big Boy (Childe Hassam Park)
info_cards.fact: "Big Boy (Childe Hassam Park)" by Various civic artists. A whimsical small-town public sculpture celebrating community life.
